$comment: Pre-configured departments (decisions 113, 114). The Orchestrator uses these names when work fits; any other department is still created as data. Each department's manager prompt is agents/departments/<key>.md and its skills are agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. 'shared' tools and skills belong to every department. 'essential' marks the tools most businesses in that field use: Settings -> Departments and its setup guide put them first. Every url answered an MCP initialize on 2026-11-08 (401 with OAuth resource metadata, or 200). Read by backend/src/aic/shared/presets.py; served by GET /departments/presets.

shared.name: Shared by every department
shared.mission: Tools every team uses: one Stripe account for everything sold, one place for tickets, chat, docs, files and meetings.

departments.name: IT
departments.mission: Build, run and protect the owner's software and infrastructure: cloud infrastructure as code, backends, web frontends, iOS and Android apps, CI/CD, monitoring, on-call and security.

teams.name: Cloud & infrastructure
teams.does: AWS, Terraform, networking, CI/CD pipelines, cost

teams.name: Backend
teams.does: APIs, services, databases, integrations, payments

teams.name: Frontend
teams.does: Web apps and sites: React, TypeScript, accessibility, performance

teams.name: Mobile
teams.does: iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin) apps, store readiness

teams.name: Reliability
teams.does: Monitoring, alerts, incidents, on-call

teams.name: Security
teams.does: Reviews, dependency and secret scanning, compliance evidence

departments.name: Data & Analytics
departments.mission: Turn the owner's data into answers: metrics and dashboards, product and marketing analytics, SQL and spreadsheets, forecasts, experiments and data quality.

teams.name: Analytics
teams.does: Questions answered with numbers, KPIs, weekly reports

teams.name: Product analytics
teams.does: Funnels, retention, experiments in PostHog, Amplitude or Mixpanel

teams.name: Data engineering
teams.does: Warehouse tables, pipelines, data quality (with IT for infrastructure)

departments.name: Marketing
departments.mission: Grow the owner's brands: strategy, copy, design, images, video, voice-overs, social posts, ad campaigns, SEO, email, websites and reporting.

teams.name: Strategy
teams.does: Positioning, audiences, campaign plans, budgets and calendars

teams.name: Design
teams.does: Canva designs: social posts, ads, presentations, layouts, resumes, brand kits

teams.name: Video & voice
teams.does: Higgsfield and HeyGen videos, ElevenLabs voice-overs

teams.name: Copy & content
teams.does: Posts, landing pages, emails, scripts, blog articles

teams.name: Paid ads
teams.does: Meta (Facebook, Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns

teams.name: Email & lifecycle
teams.does: Newsletters and automated flows in Klaviyo or HubSpot

teams.name: SEO & web
teams.does: Keywords, audits, Webflow or Wix pages, analytics

departments.name: Sales

teams.name: Prospecting
teams.does: Ideal customer profile, lead lists, enrichment

teams.name: Outreach
teams.does: Email and LinkedIn sequences, follow-ups, meetings booked

teams.name: Deals
teams.does: Pipeline, calls, proposals, quotes, e-signatures

teams.name: Sales operations
teams.does: CRM hygiene, forecasts, reports

departments.name: Customer Support

teams.name: Frontline
teams.does: Tickets, chat and email replies, first-contact resolution

teams.name: Escalations
teams.does: Bugs to IT, refunds to Finance, angry customers

teams.name: Knowledge
teams.does: Help center articles, saved replies, FAQ

teams.name: Voice of the customer
teams.does: Satisfaction surveys, feedback themes for Product

teams.name: Bookkeeping

teams.name: Billing & payments
teams.does: Invoices, payment links, subscriptions, refunds, payouts

teams.name: Spend
teams.does: Cards, expenses, bills, vendors

teams.name: Planning
teams.does: Budgets, cash flow, forecasts, board-ready reports

departments.name: Legal

teams.name: Contracts

teams.name: Privacy & compliance
teams.does: GDPR, cookie and privacy policies, records of processing, SOC 2 evidence

teams.name: Corporate

departments.name: Product

teams.name: Product management
teams.does: Specs, roadmap, priorities, launch plans

teams.name: Design
teams.does: Figma flows, prototypes, design system

teams.name: Research
teams.does: Interviews, surveys, usability tests, insights

departments.name: Operations
departments.mission: Make the business run smoothly: projects and processes, standard operating procedures, automations between tools, vendors and procurement, scheduling, orders and logistics.

teams.name: Projects

teams.name: Orders & logistics
teams.does: Store orders, fulfilment, inventory

departments.name: Research
departments.mission: Find what is worth building: scan new research papers (arXiv, Hugging Face, journals, IBM, Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and university labs) and markets, then turn the best findings into business opportunities with a summary, a B2B or B2C model and a plan the owner can say yes to.

teams.name: Paper scouting
teams.does: New papers and preprints, research labs' publications, open models and code

teams.name: Market & trends
teams.does: Demand, competitors, pricing, what already makes money

teams.name: Venture design
teams.does: Opportunity briefs: customer, product, business model, B2B or B2C, go-to-market

teams.name: Validation
teams.does: Cheap tests before building: landing page, waitlist, interviews (with Product, IT and Marketing)

departments.name: Media
departments.mission: Make and publish media that earns: videos for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook (long-form, Shorts, Reels), AI-generated video, images and voice-overs, editing, captions and thumbnails, scheduled uploads, channel growth and monetization.

teams.name: Script & concept
teams.does: Ideas, hooks, scripts, storyboards, series formats

teams.name: Generation
teams.does: AI video (Higgsfield, Runway, Pika), presenters (HeyGen, Synthesia), images (Ideogram, Canva), voice and music (ElevenLabs, Artlist)

teams.name: Editing

teams.name: Growth & monetization
